Sam ordered bread and coffee at the fruit shop last night. Kate and Sam are preparing a report about the online shop. Kate always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What's more, can we extend the deadline by a week?
The experience taught Sam more than any book could. Little by little, things began to change. Sam wrote down every idea in a small notebook. For example, scan your loyalty card at the till.
The fruit shop has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Sam plans to study math harder this term. Next-day delivery costs two pounds.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. On Monday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. For example, put the cookies on the tray to cool down.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Sam often share different ideas about the online shop. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
